newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI says finance firms must register afresh.
newsitem.headline: India RBI says finance firms must register afresh.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India said on Wednesday it had directed all non-bank finance companies to reapply for registration before July 8.

"The Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) which were already registered with the Reserve Bank under the earlier guidelines are also required to apply again to the Reserve Bank for registration," the RBI said in a statement.
It advised all NBFCs including residuary non-banking companies which have been in existence before January 9 this year but which have not yet submitted registration applications, to apply.

"All the existing NBFCs should note that if they fail to apply for a certificate of registration from the Reserve Bank of India within the stipulated time limit of July 8,1997, they will not be permitted to carry on the non-banking financial business from July 9,1997, including the acceptance of deposits from the public," the statement said.
